visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male main character with styled dark hair wears a white suit jacket. He speaks directly to the camera with a bright, expressive face, gesturing towards his skin which has a visible glow. The background is a flat, neutral gray studio wall with soft, even lighting. (2) He holds a sleek, white bottle of Shiseido foundation towards the lens, showcasing the red accent on the cap. He then pumps some onto his hand, spreading the light beige cream to demonstrate its luminous, moist texture under the studio lights. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of his face as he uses a metal makeup spatula to apply a thin layer of foundation to his cheek. He then uses his fingers to blend it seamlessly, showing the before-and-after difference in skin radiance and smoothness. (4) In the final segment, he introduces a black round loose powder container. He applies the powder over the foundation using a white puff, explaining how it maintains the glow while setting the makeup. He smiles broadly, holding both products for a final recommendation.

A subtle digital 'ding' sound effect plays as text overlays appear on the screen to highlight key points. (3) As he demonstrates the application, his speech rate remains moderate and informative. The BGM remains in the background at a low volume ratio. He uses enthusiastic adjectives like 'AMAZING,' delivered with higher intensity and a slight rising intonation to engage the audience.
